saw_lines: Nobody buys a car from one ad. Buyers compare trim, monthly rate and trade in value before the test drive.
So a car ad must name the model and monthly figure, or the buyer scrolls on to the next dealer.
Your 40 Google text ads date back to February 2025, so rewrite the first line of each around one model and its monthly price, then test three new openers.
ads_1: Paid creative led by one model and its monthly price, tested on three openers
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
